The README describes an MCP-based workflow in which an agent inspects a local target and receives findings with evidence and limitations.
The agent can use REA findings to explain behavior or write and test an implementation, and the same workflows are usable from a command line.
The maintainers position REA for lawful research, education, interoperability, software preservation, and analysis of software the user owns or is authorized to examine.
According to the README, setup uses Node.js with npm and the command npx rea-agents setup.
Setup registers REA's MCP server and matching workflow instructions, backs up existing configuration, and documents support for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, and other agents.

Firmware work uses Binwalk or Unblob on Linux; some other analysis workflows require caller-supplied tools for specific targets, including TShark for recorded packets and packet summaries, sigrok-cli for recorded logic signals, and pwntools for offline ELF layout and recorded Linux crashes.

REA, short for Reverse Engineer Anything, is an MIT-licensed TypeScript project; according to its README, it connects an agent to tools for inspecting native binaries, JavaScript and Electron applications, .NET assemblies, websites, Android APKs and devices, saved network and packet captures, firmware, model artifacts, and other targets [metadata][readme]. Its README describes an MCP-based workflow in which the agent inspects a local target, receives findings with evidence and limitations, and can use those results to explain behavior or write and test an implementation; the same workflows are usable from a command line [readme]. The maintainers position the project for lawful research, education, interoperability, software preservation, and analysis of software the user owns or is authorized to examine [readme].

According to the README, setup uses Node.js with npm and the command npx rea-agents setup; it registers REA's MCP server and matching workflow instructions, backs up existing configuration, and documents support for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and Grok Build, among others [readme]. The README states that REA requires Node.js 22.x at 22.19 or later, 24.x at 24.11 or later, or 26 or later [readme]. Target support adds dependencies: native binary analysis uses a caller-supplied Hopper, Ghidra, or IDA, though setup can optionally install Hopper with approval; static JavaScript and .NET inspection do not need a native analysis engine; Android APK analysis uses headless JADX and a full JDK; firmware work uses Binwalk or Unblob on Linux; some other analysis workflows require caller-supplied tools, including TShark for recorded packets and packet summaries, sigrok-cli for recorded logic signals, and pwntools for offline ELF layout and recorded Linux crashes [readme].

Documented caveats include local analysis with the agent receiving tool results while the model provider's data policy remains separate; Linux workflows for Ghidra, JADX, firmware tool launches, and static JavaScript or Electron analysis require a procps-compatible ps on PATH; and the 6.6.0 breaking changes state that older saved Evidence, analysis snapshots, and inventory observations are not migrated and must be regenerated [readme][release]. Release 6.6.0 also described Kuna as a caller-supplied static-analysis provider, with recorded real-provider coverage on Linux using Kuna 1.833 and no support for Windows, PE, or universal Mach-O; those release-specific limitations should not be assumed to define all current or future support [release]. Release 6.7.0 documents client-configuration fixes and says it includes the 6.6.0 changes [release].

REA-authored code is MIT-licensed, while third-party material keeps its own licenses and notices; the README states that commercial tools including IDA Pro and Hex-Rays decompilers, Hopper, and JEB must be legally obtained and used under their own terms, and that REA grants no license, key, or activation entitlement for them [metadata][readme].

scripts.zh: REA 是 Reverse Engineer Anything 的简称，是一个采用 MIT 许可证的 TypeScript 项目。根据项目说明，它把智能体连接到多种检查工具，用于分析原生二进制文件、JavaScript 和 Electron 应用、.NET 程序集、网站、Android 应用与设备、保存下来的抓包数据、固件、模型文件以及其他目标。项目说明描述了一种基于 MCP 的工作流：智能体检查本地目标，收到带有证据和局限性的结果，再利用这些结果解释行为，或编写并测试实现。同样的工作流也可以在命令行中使用。维护者将该项目定位为用于合法研究、教育、互操作、软件保存，以及分析自己拥有或获授权检查的软件。根据项目说明，安装使用 Node.js、npm 和命令 npx rea-agents setup。该命令会注册 REA 的 MCP 服务及配套工作流说明，备份现有配置，并记录支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Grok Build 及其他智能体。项目说明指出，REA 需要 Node.js 22.x，版本 22.19 及以上；24.x，版本 24.11 及以上；或 26 及以上。不同目标还需要额外依赖：原生二进制分析使用调用者提供的 Hopper、Ghidra 或 IDA，安装过程可在获得批准后选择安装 Hopper。静态 JavaScript 和 .NET 检查不需要原生分析引擎。Android APK 分析使用无界面的 JADX 和完整 JDK。Linux 上的固件工作使用 Binwalk 或 Unblob。部分其他分析工作流需要调用者提供的工具，包括：TShark 用于记录的数据包和包摘要，sigrok-cli 用于记录的逻辑信号，pwntools 用于离线 ELF 布局和记录的 Linux 崩溃。分析在本地运行；智能体接收工具结果，而模型提供商有自己的数据政策。Linux 上，Ghidra、JADX、固件工具启动以及静态 JavaScript 或 Electron 分析，需要 PATH 中存在兼容 procps 的 ps。6.6.0 版引入了破坏性变更：旧的已保存 Evidence、分析快照和清单观察结果不会迁移，必须重新生成。该版本还把 Kuna 描述为调用者提供的静态分析提供方；记录到的真实提供方覆盖在 Linux 上使用 Kuna 1.833，该覆盖不支持 Windows、PE 和通用 Mach-O。6.7.0 版记录了客户端配置修复，并说明包含 6.6.0 的变更。REA 编写的代码采用 MIT 许可证，第三方材料保留自己的许可证和声明。项目说明指出，包括 IDA Pro 与 Hex-Rays 反编译器、Hopper 和 JEB 在内的商业工具，必须合法获得并按其自身条款使用；REA 不授予这些工具的许可证、密钥或激活权益。

sections.edited: HyperFrames is an open-source framework for turning HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos [readme]. The repository metadata identifies it as a TypeScript project under Apache-2.0 [metadata], and the README also states Apache 2.0 with no per-render fees or commercial-use thresholds [readme]. It says the skills teach agents to plan the video, write valid HTML, wire seekable animations, add media, lint, preview, and render [readme]. Documented use cases include product launch videos, PR walkthroughs, data visualizations, social videos, docs-to-video, PDF-to-video, and reusable motion graphics [readme]. Setup requires Node.js 22+ and FFmpeg; a basic CLI flow is npx hyperframes init my-video, then preview and render [readme]. Full-repository development uses Git LFS for golden regression-test baselines of about 240 MB of MP4 files, while source-only clones can skip LFS content [readme]. The README warns that standalone skills installed with skills add can lag main by hours and recommends npx hyperframes skills update when the newest copy or a non-interactive core install is needed [readme]. scripts.en: HyperFrames is an open-source framework for turning HTML, CSS, media, and animations that can be sampled at specific times into deterministic MP4 videos. The repository is listed as TypeScript with Apache 2.0, and the README says the license has no per-render fees or commercial-use thresholds. The README presents HyperFrames for local use through a command-line interface, for AI coding agents through installable skills, and as a rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows. It says the skills teach agents to plan a video, write valid HTML, wire seekable animations, add media, lint, preview, and render. Documented use cases include product launch videos, pull request walkthroughs, data visualizations, social videos, docs-to-video, PDF-to-video, and reusable motion graphics. Setup requires Node.js 22 or later and FFmpeg. A basic command-line flow is npx hyperframes init my-video, then preview and render. Full-repository development uses Git LFS for golden regression-test baselines of about 240 megabytes of MP4 files; source-only clones can skip LFS content. The README warns that standalone skills installed with skills add can lag the main branch by hours and recommends npx hyperframes skills update when you need the newest copy or a non-interactive core install. Studio is described as available but evolving. The release notes record version 0.8.181, published on October 20, 2026, with fixes and performance changes.
scripts.zh: HyperFrames 是一个开源框架，用于把 HTML、CSS、媒体和可定位到任意时间点的动画转换成确定性的 MP4 视频。代码库信息显示它使用 TypeScript，许可证为 Apache 2.0；README 还表示，该许可证没有按次渲染费用，也没有商用门槛。README 将它定位为可通过命令行在本地使用、可供 AI 编程代理通过可安装技能使用，也可作为托管式创作工作流背后的渲染核心。README 说，这些技能教代理规划视频、编写有效的 HTML、接入可定位动画、添加媒体、执行检查、预览和渲染。文档列出的用例包括产品发布视频、拉取请求讲解、数据可视化、社交视频、文档转视频、PDF 转视频，以及可复用的动态图形。环境要求是 Node.js 22 或更高版本，以及 FFmpeg。基本命令行流程是运行 npx hyperframes init my-video，然后预览和渲染。完整仓库开发使用 Git LFS 保存黄金回归测试基线，约 240 MB 的 MP4 文件；如果只需要源代码，可以跳过 LFS 内容。README 提醒，使用 skills add 安装的独立技能可能比 main 分支落后数小时，并建议在需要最新副本或非交互式核心技能安装时使用 npx hyperframes skills update。Studio 被描述为可用但仍在演进。发布记录显示版本 0.8.181 于 2026 年 10 月 20 日发布，包含修复和性能变更。

claims.text: Agent Reach is the Panniantong/Agent-Reach repository, a Python project under the MIT License.
Its stated aim is to give an AI agent a single CLI for reading and searching internet platforms.
The README describes Agent Reach as a capability layer that handles backend selection, installation, health checks, and routing, while the agent directly calls upstream tools for actual reading.
It targets users of command-line-capable AI agents such as Claude Code, OpenClaw, Cursor, and Windsurf.
The README says the maintainer offers enterprise Agent customization and implementation cooperation.

Representative supported scenarios include web pages, YouTube subtitles and search, RSS, GitHub, Twitter/X, Bilibili, Reddit, Facebook, Instagram, Xiaohongshu, LinkedIn, Boss直聘, V2EX, Xueqiu, and Xiaoyuzhou podcasts.
Configuration requirements differ by platform.
A default installation can activate several zero-configuration channels, and login-required channels are configured only after the agent asks the user.
Installation and updates can be started by sending the agent a single instruction.
OpenClaw users must enable exec permissions first; otherwise the agent cannot run shell commands.
The README claims all tools are open source and all APIs are free.
The README says local use needs no proxy, while a server deployment may need a proxy for about one US dollar per month.
Credentials are stored locally in ~/.agent-reach/config.yaml with owner-only permissions and are not uploaded.
For platforms using cookies or login sessions, the README warns of platform detection and account-ban risk and recommends a dedicated alternate account.
Each platform uses an ordered primary-plus-fallback backend list.
The doctor command probes channels, reports the active backend, and a single channel failure does not take down the whole health check.
OpenCLI as a desktop backend requires a desktop environment and Chrome; after npm installation, the user must still click once in the Chrome extension store, and servers skip it automatically.
Reddit has no zero-configuration path because the anonymous interface is blocked and the official API uses approval, so a logged-in state is required.
The README attributes backend selection to real-device tests and says choices are reviewed periodically.

scripts.en: Agent Reach is a Python project under the MIT license that aims to give AI agents a single command-line way to read and search across internet platforms. Its README describes it as a capability layer rather than just another tool: it chooses among access routes, installs them, checks their health, and routes each platform to a working backend, while the agent itself calls the upstream tools to do the actual reading. It is meant for people using command-line-capable agents such as Claude Code, OpenClaw, Cursor, or Windsurf, and the maintainer also offers custom agent work for businesses. Representative uses include reading web pages, extracting YouTube subtitles and searching videos, reading RSS, working with GitHub, and accessing platforms such as Twitter (now X), Bilibili, Reddit, Facebook, Instagram, Xiaohongshu, LinkedIn, Boss Zhipin, V2EX, Xueqiu, and Xiaoyuzhou podcasts. Configuration needs vary by platform. A default install can activate several zero-configuration channels, and the agent asks before setting up platforms that need a login. Installation and updates can be started by sending the agent a single instruction. OpenClaw users must first enable exec permissions, or the agent cannot run shell commands. The README says all tools are open source and all APIs are free, with no proxy needed locally; a server deployment may need a proxy for about one dollar a month. Credentials are stored locally in a configuration file with owner-only permissions and are not uploaded. For platforms that use cookies or login sessions, the README warns about possible platform detection and account bans and recommends a dedicated alternate account. Where a platform has more than one backend, the project tries them in order, primary first, then fallbacks; some platforms, such as web pages, YouTube, RSS and GitHub, rely on a single tool. Its doctor command probes the channels and reports which backend is active; a single channel failure does not take down the whole health check. OpenCLI, used as a desktop backend for some platforms, requires a desktop environment and Chrome; after npm installs it, the user still has to click once in the Chrome extension store, and servers skip it automatically. Reddit has no zero-configuration path because the anonymous interface has been blocked and the official API uses approval, so a logged-in state is required. The README attributes its selection choices to real-device tests and says they are reviewed periodically.
scripts.zh: Agent Reach 是一个采用 MIT 许可证的 Python 项目，目标是在一个命令行工具中，让 AI Agent 能读取和搜索多个互联网平台。README 把它定位为能力层，而不只是又一个工具：它负责选择接入方式、安装、体检和路由，具体读取由 Agent 直接调用上游工具完成。它面向能运行命令行工具的 AI Agent 用户，例如 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Cursor 和 Windsurf；维护者也承接面向企业的 Agent 定制与落地合作。可用场景包括阅读网页、提取 YouTube 字幕和搜索视频、阅读 RSS、使用 GitHub，以及访问 Twitter（现为 X）、B站、Reddit、Facebook、Instagram、小红书、LinkedIn、Boss直聘、V2EX、雪球和小宇宙播客等平台，不同平台需要的配置不同。默认安装可以启用若干零配置渠道，需要登录的平台会由 Agent 询问后再配置。安装和更新都可以通过给 Agent 一句指令开始。OpenClaw 用户必须先开启 exec 权限，否则 Agent 无法执行 shell 命令。README 称所有工具开源、所有 API 免费，本地使用不需要代理；如果部署在服务器上，代理可能约每月一美元。凭据保存在本地配置文件中，文件权限仅所有者可读写，不会上传。对需要使用 Cookie 或登录态的平台，README 提醒可能被平台检测并封号，建议使用专用小号。对于拥有多个后端的平台，项目按顺序先用首选、再用备选；网页、YouTube、RSS 和 GitHub 等部分平台只依赖单一工具。doctor 命令会探测各渠道并报告当前使用哪个后端；单个渠道故障不会拖垮整个体检。OpenCLI 作为部分平台的桌面后端，需要桌面环境和 Chrome，npm 自动安装后仍需在 Chrome 扩展商店手动点一次，服务器会自动跳过。Reddit 没有零配置路径，因为匿名接口已被封锁，官方 API 采用审批制，所以必须使用登录态。README 称这些选型基于真机实测，并会定期复核。

Diagram Design is an Agent Skill from cathrynlavery/diagram-design that the maintainer describes as drawing editorial diagrams as one self-contained HTML plus SVG file, in the user's brand, with 45 diagram types and an opinionated style of one accent color, hairline borders, no shadows, and a four-pixel grid [readme]. Repository metadata describes editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, and Pi, with 44 diagram types, self-contained HTML plus SVG, no shadows, and “No Mermaid slop” [metadata]. The README also says each diagram type has one number, 01 to 44, while calling the set 45 diagram types; the metadata's 44 count and the README's 45 count conflict [readme][metadata].

Intended users work in Agent Skills-compatible hosts, including Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Qoder, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Cline, Windsurf, and Amp [readme]. The skill accepts plain-language prompts for diagram types such as architecture, quadrant, and sequence with token refresh, and it can redraw draw.io, Mermaid, or Excalidraw sources with format, size, detail, and audience controls [readme]. Output is one HTML file with inline SVG that opens by double-clicking; motion is optional, defaults to none, and reduced-motion output shows a complete static frame [readme].

Setup can be done with npx skills add cathrynlavery/diagram-design for Agent Skills hosts, or with native plugin or install commands for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, Pi, and Qoder; the README also documents Claude Cowork, Kiro, OpenCode, and editable installs [readme]. The README states that official builds come only from this repository and that LittleMight, Cathryn Lavery's company, publishes the plugin directory listings [readme]. Brand onboarding fetches a website homepage, extracts a dominant palette and font stack, maps values to semantic roles, shows a proposed diff, and checks WCAG AA contrast before writing tokens [readme]. Named profiles stored under ~/.diagram-design/profiles/ can be selected per project with a .diagram-design marker [readme].

SVG and PNG export are documented; PNG export uses Playwright and requires one-time Chromium setup [readme]. By default a diagram loads Instrument Serif, Geist, and Geist Mono from Google Fonts, described as the only network request; system-font mode removes network requests [readme]. The license is MIT [metadata].

The maintainer notes real limitations: output quality depends on the model, the same prompt can lay out differently twice, and the result is not an editable source format with a text diff in a pull request or a canvas to drag [readme]. For documentation that lives in Git and changes every sprint, the README says Mermaid is still the better fit [readme].

scripts.en: Diagram Design is an Agent Skill from cathrynlavery/diagram-design. The maintainer presents it as a way to draw editorial diagrams as a single self-contained HTML file with inline SVG, in your brand. The README describes forty-five diagram types and a style with one accent color, hairline borders, no shadows, and a four-pixel grid. The repository metadata, however, says forty-four diagram types, and the README also says the gallery numbers types from zero one to forty-four, so the count is inconsistent. The skill is intended for people working in Agent Skills-compatible coding-agent hosts, including Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Qoder, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Cline, Windsurf, Amp, Factory Droid, and Pi. You can ask in plain language for architecture, quadrant, sequence, and other diagrams, and it can redraw draw.io, Mermaid, or Excalidraw sources with controls for format, size, detail, and audience. The result is one HTML file with inline SVG that opens locally. Motion is optional, defaults to none, and reduced-motion output stays on a complete static frame. Setup can use the skills command line or native plugin or install commands for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, Pi, and Qoder; the README also covers Claude Cowork, Kiro, OpenCode, and editable installs. The README says official builds come only from this repository, and that LittleMight, Cathryn Lavery's company, publishes the plugin directory listings. Brand onboarding can fetch a website homepage, extract the palette and font stack, map values to semantic roles, show a proposed diff, and check WCAG AA contrast before writing tokens. Named profiles can be stored and selected per project. SVG and PNG export are documented; PNG export uses Playwright and needs a one-time Chromium setup. By default the diagram loads Instrument Serif, Geist, and Geist Mono from Google Fonts, described as the only network request; system-font mode removes network requests. The license is MIT. The maintainer also notes real limitations: output quality depends on the model, the same prompt can lay out differently twice, and the result is not an editable source format with a text diff or a canvas to drag. For documentation that lives in Git and changes every sprint, the README says Mermaid is still the better fit.
scripts.zh: Diagram Design 是 cathrynlavery/diagram-design 的一个 Agent Skill。维护者把它描述为：用单个自包含的 HTML 文件加内联 SVG 来绘制编辑风格的图表，并匹配你的品牌。项目说明写到四十五种图表类型，风格使用一种强调色、细线边框、没有阴影和四像素网格。但仓库元数据写的是四十四种，项目说明里还说每种图表在展示页中编号为零一到四十四，所以图表数量并不一致。这个技能面向使用 Agent Skills 兼容编码智能体宿主的人，包括 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex、Qoder、GitHub Copilot、Gemini CLI、Cline、Windsurf、Amp、Factory Droid 和 Pi。你可以用自然语言要求架构图、象限图、带令牌刷新的时序图等，也可以重绘 draw.io、Mermaid 或 Excalidraw 源文件，并控制格式、尺寸、细节和受众。输出是一个带内联 SVG 的 HTML 文件，可在本地打开。动效可选，默认关闭，减少动态效果时显示完整的静态画面。安装可以用 skills 命令行，也可以用 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot、Factory Droid、Pi 和 Qoder 的原生插件或安装命令；项目说明还记录了 Claude Cowork、Kiro、OpenCode 和可编辑安装方式。项目说明称，官方构建只来自这个仓库，LittleMight 是 Cathryn Lavery 的公司，负责发布插件目录条目。品牌接入可以抓取网站首页，提取主色板和字体栈，映射到语义角色，显示建议差异，并在写入设计令牌前检查 WCAG AA 对比度。命名配置档案可以保存，并按项目选择。文档记录了 SVG 和 PNG 导出；PNG 导出使用 Playwright，需要一次性安装 Chromium。默认情况下，图表会从 Google Fonts 加载 Instrument Serif、Geist 和 Geist Mono，项目说明称这是唯一的网络请求；系统字体模式会移除网络请求。许可证是 MIT。维护者也说明了实际限制：输出质量取决于所用模型，同一个提示两次可能得到不同版式，结果不是可编辑的源格式，没有可在拉取请求中比较的文本差异，也没有可拖拽的画布。对于放在 Git 中并每个迭代都会变化的文档，项目说明仍认为 Mermaid 更合适。
